summary: Independent reachability walk finds a coupled Go control plane plus C++ dataplane with real apply/rollout/recovery/drain/proxy paths. Measured substantive environment LOC is 3924; conservative honest reachable estimate remains ~3693 after discounting near-clone node JSON beyond three zone templates, clearing the large_system_strict 3000 floor. TOY_LOGIC_RISK LOW; PADDING_RISK LOW.

evidence.observation: Edition 3 metadata with artifacts=/app/sovereign-lb, separate verifier mode, agent timeout 7200s; languages go/cpp/bash/python.
Entrypoint opens api.Service, serves HTTP management and TCP dataplane control listeners against durable state.
Operator CLI reaches apply/status/nodes/fleet/scenarios/health/retention/recovery plus local fleet.LoadInventory and catalog.LoadDirectory.

Open() bootstraps recovery, retention, readiness, health, fleet profiles, and scenarios; Apply chains validation, revision fencing, snapshot compile/store, retention leases, rollout begin, and prepare dispatch; handlers call ops.ReconcileFleet/GenerationAlignment.
Control stream registers sessions, accepts prepared/active/rejected/status, drives rollout phase transitions, and promotes active generation.
Fleet membership and generation-alignment reconciliation used from status/fleet HTTP surfaces; not an orphan package.
Dataplane wires checkpoint restore, eligibility/health, DrainManager, ActiveProber, Proxy, StatusServer, and ControlClient on dedicated threads.
Epoll L4 proxy with listener reconcile, eligibility selection, PROXY v2 header, bidirectional transfer, idle/connect expiry—dense domain logic despite compact line layout.
DrainManager transitions targets across snapshot generations, retains retired runtimes, and sweeps stale references.
Lab entrypoint executes tools/lab/backends.py for multi-behavior backend endpoints used by operator workflows.

Validator-method substantive_loc=3924 with 0 duplicated code fingerprints; all internal/* Go packages reachable from cmd/*; all dataplane headers reachable from main.cpp; 24 node JSON files are zone-templated operational inventory (~264 LOC).

findings.why_it_matters: Twenty-four node JSON profiles are near-identical aside from id/port/zone. They are loaded by fleet workflows and are domain-plausible, but they are repetitive config rather than deep logic. Absolute contribution (~264 LOC) does not drive the 3000 floor.
findings.minimal_remediation: None required for PASS; optional collapse to generated-from-fleet profiles if future edits keep expanding clones.

change_scope: Cold independent Q6 production-logic review at task_commit 7b32e8ad; inspected task.toml and full solver-visible environment/ only.
do_not_change: Operator entrypoints lb-control-plane, lbctl, lb-dataplane, lab

role_output.SUBSTANTIVE_LOC_ASSESSMENT: Measured substantive environment LOC 3924 (validator blank/comment exclusion). Conservative honest reachable estimate ~3693 after discounting near-clone node JSON beyond three zone templates. Both clear large_system_strict >=3000 floor. Scale comes from control-plane packages, dataplane runtime, lab tooling, and scenario/desired config—not dead modules.
MAJOR_MODULES: cmd/lb-control-plane + internal/api: management HTTP, apply pipeline, control-stream fanout
internal/model + snapshot + revision + persistence: desired validation, compile, durable generations, idempotent revisions
internal/rollout + nodes + readiness + retention + recovery + health + ops: quorum publish, fencing, leases, bootstrap, membership
internal/fleet + catalog + cmd/lbctl: fleet inventory/profiles and scenario catalog operator surface
dataplane proxy/connection/selector/eligibility/health/drain/prober/checkpoint/control/status: live L4 path and generation lifecycle
tools/lab: deterministic backend behaviors for lab traffic
PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Fixing HTTP apply without control-stream prepare/activate quorum leaves rollout stuck
Recovering current pointer without retention/authority alignment can strand leased generations
Dataplane activate without DrainManager/runtime retain breaks in-flight streams across generation cuts
Fleet inventory without ops membership/readiness can report healthy while nodes lag active generation
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing ~25% of solver-visible core (api apply/control, rollout, recovery/retention, dataplane proxy/drain/snapshot parse) collapses operator apply, readiness, and live TCP serving. Removing only node JSON clones or thin audit/metrics shells leaves the operational system largely intact—evidence those are not the scale source.
